title: RemakeEngine Module Configuration (config.toml)
description: Schema for module-level configuration providing placeholder variables to the engine. Uses [[placeholders]] array-of-tables. Placeholder keys support alphanumeric characters, dots (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

placeholders.description: Array of placeholder maps. Later entries override earlier ones. Keys/values are merged into the engine context for placeholder resolution. Keys can use [\w\.-]+ format.
